Sam R.: quick sync: Datadog raised a concern about high-cardinality attributes for customers running model ensembles (many model combos per request). they want guidance so their tile doesn't blow ingestion quotas.
Tasha (eng): we should provide a templated transform: 1) keep model.family as high-cardinality, 2) collapse model.variant to a small set (prod/canary/exp) via mapping, 3) emit ensemble.hash for grouping instead of listing each model in a span.
Rahul (obs): DD suggested a recommended pipeline that hashes long lists and emits count metrics instead of per-model metrics when cardinality > 10. they also want an example dashboard that aggregates by ensemble.hash.
Jen (legal): legal asks we document that hashed identifiers are non-reversible and include KMS key handling for HMAC keys. also need a blurb for the marketplace that explains telemetry limits and opt-in sampling defaults.
Sam R.: action items: Tasha to draft transform + collector snippet, Rahul to author dashboard JSON and sampling recommendations, Jen to prepare legal blurb. integrations-bot please create a ticket.
integrations-bot: Created RDW-5333: "DD tile - high-cardinality ensemble guidance" assigned to Tasha (eng) and Rahul (obs). Due: 2025-06-05.
Tasha (eng): collector transform (short): `attributes.processors` to map model.variant -> {prod,canary,exp}, compute `ensemble.hash = hmac_sha256(instance_key, join(model_ids))`, drop `model.ids` if count > 10. will post snippet to ticket.
Rahul (obs): dashboard panels: 1) Ensemble throughput by ensemble.hash, 2) p50/p95 latency by model.family, 3) per-host GPU util. will export JSON after Tasha posts sample metrics.
Sam R.: schedule a 30m smoke with Datadog next Tue 10:00 PT. keep this thread as source of truth and attach artifacts to RDW-5333.
Jen (legal): I'll add required wording for the cert packet: HMAC algo, rotation cadence, no-reversible claim, and sampling defaults.
Sam R.: thanks team. ping here if anything blocks.
